a.text: Hartmann was commander of both and 2nd U-boat Flotilla.

b.text: Hartmann became commander of the 2nd ULD (U-boat Training Division).

a.text: Werner Hartmann received the U-boat War Badge with Diamonds.

b.text: Werner Hartmann received the 645th Oak Leaves as Kapitän zur See and leader of the U-Boote in the Mediterranean Sea.
